subject: prd/skill-command-prefix
statement: When a pyxis harness skill is published on the distributable agent surface, the system shall identify it by the single string `pyxis-` concatenated with its pre-rename basename (no shortening), used identically as skill directory basename, frontmatter `name:`, slash-command identity, and matching authoring-guide filename.
fit_criterion: for every skill on the live skills tree after the train, directory basename = frontmatter `name:` = `pyxis-<pre-rename-basename>`; matching authoring guide filename uses the same stem
